# GOAL


A UnIFIED CLI tool to manage multiple forges 


it should be able to 
  1. create repo
  2. rename repo 
  3. delete repo
  4. list repos
  5. change visibility
  6. manage run status
  7. manage workflows
  8. manage projects

## and things should and must be uniform for any forges ...



ENV VARIABLES 



FORGIT_GITHUB_TOKEN=
FORGIT_GITLAB_TOKEN=
FORGIT_CODEBERG_TOKEN=

or use 
~/.config/forgit/config.toml 

it should support multiple instances of the same forge like gitlab, sourcehut, forgejo
